summary.zh: 判断 A/B 差异是真实提升还是随机波动
summary.en: Separate a real A/B lift from noise using significance tests

description.zh: 用显著性检验和置信区间判断 A/B 结果里的差异是真实提升还是随机波动，并给出所需样本量和测试时长。适合质疑某个指标的变化、判断哪个版本胜出，或设计下一次实验时使用。
description.en: Uses significance tests, confidence intervals, sample size and test duration to separate a real A/B lift from noise. Use it to challenge a metric move, pick the winning variant or size the next experiment.
